text.card: A red giant 1,169 parsecs away, 23 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.25 solar masses and 22.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,407 K at its surface.
